evidence.claim: On the synthetic delayed-reuse suite, ASG retention reduces effective prefill tokens relative to lru-system.
evidence.why_previous_bars_matched: Placement and prefetch policies use the same ASG v2 retention objective for effective_prefill_tokens; their differences appear in traffic and communication metrics.

limitations: Synthetic traces validate controlled algorithm behavior only; they cannot support real-trace paper claims.
Bars use full synthetic suite summary at the default paper-eval setting, not a hardware-measured deployment trace.
